_about: PRIOR ART: none — hand-assembled 2026-11-11 from the experiment log (scripts/eval/experiments/), one row per repair route that has been measured. Each row cites the write-up whose numbers it quotes. Rendered by the error zoo page. Update a row when its experiment is superseded.

statuses.ready: Fixable now: measured, waiting on a decision
statuses.gated: Fixable with more work: a gate failed
statuses.contain: Not fixable yet: withhold and label

routes.route: Opus corrects the stored OCR in place
routes.when: Printed books whose OCR is a Flash-Lite draft. Measured in Latin, German, Chinese, Greek, Sanskrit and Arabic.
routes.result: Pages a blind Opus reader called misleading fell from 63 to 6 of 250 (German), 57 to 5 of 75 (Chinese), 208 to 26 of 250 (Sanskrit), 193 to 44 of 250 (Arabic). Head to head against a Flash re-read it won 61 to 7 and 214 to 14. Made worse: 1 of 196 changed pages (#6694).
routes.weak: Greek manuscripts: 245 to 87 of 250, still a third misleading. Pages the corrector marks CONTAIN need a fresh read.
routes.cost: About 5% of one Claude account-week per 1,000 pages. No API spend.

routes.route: Gemini Flash (agy) corrects the Flash-Lite draft
routes.result: Pages the Opus judge accepts rose from 37 to 45 of 60 (German) and 27 to 34 of 43 (French). 0 pages lost, no wrong text added. CER on 40 Wikisource pages 1.5% to 1.1%.
routes.weak: Pages where a guard refused the correction keep the Flash-Lite draft: 10 of 15 German and 11 of 17 French of those still fail.
routes.cost: One agy call a page, Gemini Ultra plan.

routes.route: Re-translate the page from its own leaf, one page a call
routes.when: English that belongs to the neighbouring leaf (the image is right, the translation is one page off).
routes.result: The new English is on its own leaf 30 of 30 times (the stored English: 2 of 30). Severity-weighted defects 22 against 114. Adopted: 11,944 pages in 2,608 books queued.
routes.weak: Where the OCR itself is one leaf off, the OCR has to be re-read first.
routes.cost: agy Gemini Flash, one call a page.

routes.route: Re-translate English that repeats a neighbour's text
routes.when: The leak detector flags a page pair; 88% of its flags are real.
routes.result: The duplicate is gone on 29 of 30 pages, but only 24 of 30 come out usable. The 6 failures: 3 from the page's own OCR, 3 engine errors.
routes.weak: Fails its gate. The OCR has to be checked against the neighbours first.
routes.cost: agy Gemini Flash, one call a page.

routes.route: Re-translate with Gemini 3.8 Flash from good OCR
routes.when: Lite-era translations where the OCR is right.
routes.result: +0.35 fidelity on 363 pages, but more reversed meanings than the old text (26 against 19), so the reversal gate failed pooled. Opus re-translating 738 corrected Tibetan leaves invented nothing on the leaves checked by eye.
routes.weak: Sense flips with correct OCR are the hardest class to detect (about half are caught), so the pages to re-translate are hard to find.

routes.when: OCR that repeats a block until the token limit.
routes.result: The loop goes away (29 of 30), but the new reads carry more invented spans than the old ones (176 against 131). Opus accepts 1 of 30. Rejected.
routes.weak: Trim the looping tail instead (a deterministic fix, #4850).

routes.when: Leaves with little or no text, where the model invents a page.
routes.result: No invented entries after re-translation, but background still leaks into glosses: 26 of 30 clean against a bar of 27. Rejected; 547 pages stay withheld.
routes.weak: Confabulation on manuscripts has no measured fix. Handwritten pages carry five times the confabulation of printed ones.

routes.route: Raw tags in the stored text
routes.when: Reviewers read the stored payload, not the page a reader sees.
routes.result: The reader already moves <summary>, <keywords>, <sig>, <page-num>, <header> and <vocab> out of the reading text and renders <leaf-break/> and <column-break/>. Most of these findings never reach a reader.
routes.weak: The fix is to the review brief: tell reviewers which tags the reader strips.
